title: John Glasgow, 1st Foot pension register, admission 26 March 1817 and death 12 January 1848

citations.name: John Glasgow
citations.type: John Glasgow, 1st Foot pension register, admission 26 March 1817 and death 12 January 1848
citations.assertion: Compatible existing identity of the single recorded John; no second soldier or parent relationship asserted.. Original WO 23/36, printed p.26 facing p.25: John Glasgow, 1st Foot, admitted 26 March 1817, residence Glasgow; Died 12 Jan in the 1848 column. This date belongs to the registered pensioner; profile identification is inferred. The originals name no father, mother, wife or children and give no Struthers Street address. Identification with the Calton household and the memorial profile remains inferred, not a completed merger. The 1848 memorial is a derivative lead without an inspected grave photograph. The 1782 indexed child attached to 2875 remains a separate unproved childhood-to-adult identification: its inspected FamilySearch entry gives only August 1782, Glasgow and no parents. No father is invented or assigned; both live profiles currently have no parents. No relationship percentage, structural attachment, birth field or death field changes, and no confidence-progress gain is counted. John Glasgow: Compatible existing identity of the single recorded John; no second soldier or parent relationship asserted.; John Glasgow: Compatible existing identity of the single recorded John; no second soldier or parent relationship asserted. Reviewed 2026-10-31; Original scans privately retained; new original reading, existing 7 October index lead.
